description: The facts for proposing what Monity could watch for this person: what their account already has of each product, which products are open to it (and each one's chip: Beta or early access), the room left on the plan, the sites it already watches, the weekly summary's one suggestion when one fits, and for each open product what it is for, what one costs a month and which tools set it up. Call it when the account is empty, when the person asks what to monitor, or after a setup for one next idea. It creates nothing and reads no website: look at the site yourself.
name: suggest_setup
title: What could Monity set up here
